# Vendored libraries

Both are single files that run in the browser with no build step. See `docs/journal.md` for how the journal uses them.

| Library | Version | Licence | Source | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| marked (Markdown parser) | 18.1.3 | MIT | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@18.1.3/lib/marked.umd.js | `c34a221dc89e91833a88822e7717b8a0cf27118f8c9a8779dffb48a6be31f97a` |
| highlight.js (common languages build) | 11.12.0 | BSD-3-Clause | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/highlightjs/cdn-release@11.12.0/build/highlight.min.js | `8ab71eb09c51f501e5e25157d9cff100e46cc29bcbfc744d0b746d451fca7f53` |

To upgrade: replace the file, update this table and `docs/journal.md`, and re-test an article.
